title.label: Great for people with movement disorders like Parkinson’s.  Saves a lot of unnecessary typing!

content.label: This is a great app for people with movement disorders like Parkinson’s because it does with accuracy take the notes and eliminates the keyboard, especially for anyone who suffers from neurological disorders with a tremor. It’s a great application that can be used on all of my devices, which is a big bonus. Two thumbs up! P.S. Do you offer any sort of accessibility discount?
